entry.title: Publication of amendment to FSA-designated accounting standards for consolidated financial statements and public comment results
entry.summary: 「連結財務諸表の用語、様式及び作成方法に関する規則に規定する金融庁長官が定める企業会計の基準を指定する件の一部を改正する件」の公布及びパブリックコメントの結果の公表 金融庁 · Sep 29, 2026 · RuleThe Japan Financial Services Agency published an amendment to the notice designating accounting standards under the consolidated financial statements regulation, after a public comment period that received two comments. The amendment adds international standards issued by the IASB, including the removal of IFRS 14 Regulatory Deferral Accounts, the addition of IFRS 20 Regulatory Assets and Regulatory Liabilities, and amendments to IAS 28. The notice takes effect on the date of promulgation.

entry.title: Announcement of the cross-industry Delta Wall 2026 cybersecurity exercise for Japan's financial sector
entry.summary: 「金融業界横断的なサイバーセキュリティ演習 （Delta Wall 2026）」の実施の公表 金融庁 · Oct 5, 2026 · ReportThe Financial Services Agency announced on October 5, 2026, that the 11th cross-industry cybersecurity exercise, Delta Wall 2026, will run from October 6 to 22, with about 181 financial institutions scheduled to take part. The exercise uses scenarios for banks, securities firms, insurers, fund transfer providers and crypto-asset exchange operators, testing initial response, investigation, customer handling and recovery. Results will be fed back to the wider industry, with an emphasis on improvement measures and good practices.

entry.title: Basel Committee Revises G-SIB Assessment Framework and Seeks Comment on Methodology Review
entry.summary: 国際関係,バーゼル銀行監督委員会による「グローバルなシステム上重要な銀行（G-SIB）－ウィンドウ・ドレッシング行動に対処するための評価枠組みの改訂」及び市中協議文書「G-SIB評価手法のレビュー」について公表しました。 金融庁 · Oct 23, 2026 · GuidanceThe Basel Committee on Banking Supervision has finalised revisions to the G-SIB assessment framework to address window dressing. Most indicators used for G-SIB selection will move to annual averages. A consultation paper also asks whether cross-border exposures within the European Banking Union should be included in the G-SIB framework. Comments are due by 14 January in the Japanese calendar year 9 (2027), in English.

entry.title: FSA recruits a lawyer for financial monitoring of crypto-asset exchanges and other firms

entry.title: Administrative sanctions against Prudential Life Insurance, Gibraltar Life Insurance and Prudential Holding of Japan
entry.summary: プルデンシャル生命保険株式会社、ジブラルタ生命保険株式会社及びプルデンシャル・ホールディング・オブ・ジャパン株式会社に対する行政処分の公表 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 · EnforcementThe Financial Services Agency imposed administrative sanctions on Prudential Life Insurance, Gibraltar Life Insurance and Prudential Holding of Japan. Prudential Life Insurance received a business suspension order barring insurance solicitation and contract conclusion from October 13, 2026 to January 31, 2027, along with a business improvement order. Gibraltar Life Insurance and the holding company received business improvement orders. The grounds include improper handling of money by sales staff, improper solicitation and deficient customer information management.

entry.title: Warning on Unauthorized Access and Improper Trading on Internet Brokerage Services (FSA Page Update)
entry.summary: 「インターネット取引サービスへの不正アクセス・不正取引にご注意ください」のページの更新 金融庁 · Oct 9, 2026 · GuidanceJapan's Financial Services Agency updated a warning about unauthorized access to internet trading accounts, where customer login IDs and passwords are stolen through phishing sites that imitate securities firms. In many cases, perpetrators sell shares in victims' accounts and use the proceeds to buy small-cap stocks in Japan and abroad. The page lists preventive measures such as avoiding suspicious links, using bookmarks, enabling multi-factor authentication, and not reusing passwords, and includes a table of incident statistics from April 2025 to September 2026.

entry.title: FSA Amends Notice Designating Financial Institutions Under Article 17 of the Act on Deposit Account Management Using Individual Numbers
entry.summary: 「預貯金者の意思に基づく個人番号の利用による預貯金口座の管理等に関する法律第十七条の規定に基づき金融機関を定める件」の一部改正の公表 金融庁 · Oct 13, 2026 · RuleThe Financial Services Agency, with the Ministry of Finance, MHLW, MAFF and METI, partially amended the notice designating financial institutions under Article 17 of the Act on Account Management Using Individual Numbers at the depositor's will. The amendment takes effect on October 13, 2026. It adds Mitsubishi UFJ Emit Bank Co., Ltd. and removes Amakusa Fishery Cooperative. Public comment procedures were not conducted because the notice does not fall under the orders covered by the Administrative Procedure Act.

entry.title: Public notice of a draft revision to auditing standards for public comment
entry.summary: 「監査基準の改訂について（公開草案）」についての公表 金融庁 · Oct 16, 2026 · Draft / consultationJapan's Financial Services Agency, through its Business Accounting Council Auditing Subcommittee, published a public draft revising the auditing standards, with comments accepted until November 16, 2026. The draft covers audit procedures and auditor's report disclosures on going concern assumptions, and auditors' responsibilities regarding fraud that causes material misstatements. It proposes that the going-concern evaluation period cover at least one year after the approval date of the financial statements.
